scenes.script: Five small habits that make a morning calm. Number one changed mine.
Five. Lay out your clothes the night before.
Four. Drink a glass of water before your coffee.
Three. Open the window, and let the light in.
Two. Write the one task that matters today.
And one. Leave your phone in another room until you are dressed.
So: clothes, water, window, task, and phone. Which one will you try tomorrow?
